body.statement:
Conditional on effective compatibility density, the effective moving-remainder assumption, and effective moving-offset encoding, suppose
\[
 p_n(0)\to p_0,\qquad
 p_n(u)-p_0\in\operatorname{lin}(\mathcal P_{\mathrm{ASC}}-p_0),\qquad
 c_n\to c\in\mathcal K_0,
\]
and \(\sup_{u\in C,j}|e_{n,j}(u)|\to0\) for every rational compact polytope \(C\).  Here \(\mathcal K_0=\{A_\Psi z:z\in\operatorname{lin}(\mathcal P_{\mathrm{ASC}}-p_0)\}\), so \(c_n\in\mathcal K_0\).  Compute rational \(\widehat c_n\in\mathcal K_0\) with \(\|\widehat c_n-c_n\|_\infty\le\xi_n\), apply \(\operatorname{CertGluePFL}\) at vanishing accuracy to the encoded experiment \(\mathfrak G_0(\widehat c_n)\), and transport its rule through the positive-cell multinomial comparison kernel.  On each fixed compact \(C\), the semantic-label coverage deficit and separated-risk excess are bounded by the comparison error, \(\mathfrak b_0(\tau_n+\xi_n)\), the moving-remainder charge, covariance and Gaussian-tail enclosures, semantic-union diameter inflation, and \(\rho_{\mathrm{led}}\).  The two effective moduli and certificate ledger compute \(\tau_n,\xi_n\downarrow0\) for which this compact-set bound vanishes.  The rule uses computable approximations to \(c_n\), not the unknown limit \(c\).  This does not assert global honesty on every unbounded region \(D_{n,v}\).
body.justification: The finite slack list, compatibility subspace, and Gaussian band charge make offset adaptation a determinate uniform theorem rather than a promissory phrase.
body.gap: Kaido, Molinari, and Stoye calibrate drifting moment inequalities but do not transport a finite-label Gaussian minimax rule; Carter's kernel does not define or localize an active tangent arrangement.
body.consumer: The Job Corps rule handles known root-\(n\) drifts in the capacity, generalized-inverse, and endpoint-program faces while charging every observation falling near one of the explicitly enumerated active boundaries.

obligation.what_is_open: Construct the transported compact rule and propagate comparison, boundary, covariance, tail, semantic-union, and ledger charges with exact constants.
obligation.obstruction: The corrected causal offset space and effective remainder remove legality and diagonal defects, but the quantitative experiment-comparison lemma is absent. Compact localization also cannot establish global honesty.
obligation.attempted: The exact slack decomposition and univariate Gaussian band calculation localize every compact sign disagreement; the offset-space correction now makes each limiting causal chart well typed.
obligation.partial_result:
If \(|e_{n,j}(u)|<\tau\) and \(|c_{n,j}+a_j'u|>\tau\), then \(\zeta_{n,j}(u)\) and \(c_{n,j}+a_j'u\) have the same sign.  Since \(a_j'W_0\) is normal with variance \(a_j'\Sigma_0a_j>0\),
\[
 \Pr\{|c_{n,j}+a_j'W_0|\le\tau\}
 \le \min\left\{1,\frac{2\tau}{\sqrt{2\pi}\{a_j'\Sigma_0a_j\}^{1/2}}\right\}.
\]
Summing over active facets gives \(\mathfrak b_0(\tau)\).  The corrected causal offset space and effective rational approximations make \(\mathfrak G_0(\widehat c_n)\) a valid encoded input, with offset error absorbed by replacing \(\tau\) with \(\tau+\xi_n\).  Compact localization still does not construct a globally honest rule on all unbounded \(D_{n,v}\).
